home.metaTitle: Speedcubing Türkiye: WCA competitions in Türkiye
home.metaDescription: The calendar of WCA competitions held in Türkiye, national rankings and guides for competitors.
home.noUpcomingText: New competitions show up here as soon as they are announced. Subscribe to the newsletter so you don't miss one.
home.upcomingNewsletterText: We send an email when a new WCA competition in Türkiye is announced.
home.stepsTitle: Three steps to your first competition
home.step1Text: Sign up for free at worldcubeassociation.org; your WCA ID is assigned after your first competition.
home.step2Text: Pick one from the calendar and register on the WCA site; pay the fee as the organizer describes.
home.step3Text: Arrive early, bring your cube and skim the short rules in the guide.
home.followText: Follow us on social media for new competitions, announcements and photos.
